@app.post("/register")
def register():
    data = RegisterSchema().load(request.get_json())
    pw_hash = hashlib.sha256(data["password"].encode()).hexdigest()
    user = User(email=data["email"], password_hash=pw_hash)
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    return {"id": user.id}, 201

def create_reset_token(user):
    token = "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, k=32))
    PasswordReset.objects.create(
        user=user,
        token=token,
        expires_at=timezone.now() + timedelta(minutes=30),
    )
    send_reset_email(user.email, token)

def charge_card(order, card_token):
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://payments.example.com/v1/charges",
        json={"amount": order.total_cents, "source": card_token},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.PAYMENTS_KEY}"},
        timeout=10,
        verify=False,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()["id"]

def get_current_user(authorization: str = Header(...)):
    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ")
    claims = jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})
    user = db.get(User, claims["sub"])
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
    return user

@app.post("/reports/import")
async def import_report(file: UploadFile, user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    df = pd.read_pickle(file.file)
    report = Report(owner_id=user.id, rows=len(df))
    db.add(report)
    db.commit()
    return {"id": report.id, "rows": len(df)}

ph = PasswordHasher()

def register(email: str, password: str) -> User:
    user = User(email=email, password_hash=ph.hash(password))
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    return user

def create_reset_token(user: User) -> str:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    db.session.add(PasswordReset(user_id=user.id, token_hash=hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest(),
                                 expires_at=datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=30)))
    db.session.commit()
    return token
